receiver.message_back: Delmar can increase its offer to USD 24,000,000, payable within 30 days after signing, provided the agreement includes a mutual release and customary confidentiality exceptions for legal, tax, and regulatory disclosures. Please let us know whether Harrow will accept on that basis.

delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 32,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds within 30 days after both parties have signed this Agreement. Plaintiff shall provide wire instructions in writing. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
